body:
This sounds cool.  The idea is to support the growth of Edgeware on social media platforms and increase awareness.

[@Shankar Warang](/edgeware/account/jA7pLH65zgRNA4UgwqHEWWRxTgg51wuAUgfzmZoYWM2dMVS) has been supportive  in all my major campaigns for edgeware so I'm up for this.

Sounds great - there isn't currently a way to fund EDG monthly or in dollar equivalent, we're still using project funds, that are then accessed by contributors as they need and working out the 7 day trailing average price manually.

This should change going forward as we develop capabilities.

How about we pre-fund 6 months of EDG into a multisig at our current price and then you can be a signatory alongside two other trusted community members such as [@Shankar Warang](/edgeware/account/jA7pLH65zgRNA4UgwqHEWWRxTgg51wuAUgfzmZoYWM2dMVS) or one of the moderators?
